name: pagepulse-skills
description: Page Pulse SEO skills for Claude: measure and act on real page-change data.

plugins.name: change-autopsy
plugins.description: Measure whether a page change helped, hurt, or did nothing, using Page Pulse change tracking with Search Console and GA4 outcomes.

plugins.name: competitor-watch
plugins.description: Watch competitor pages for real changes, get alerted by email or Slack, and summarize what competitors changed so you can respond.

plugins.name: geo-measurement-loop
plugins.description: Measure whether content optimized for AI answers and AI Overviews actually moved your search outcomes, using Page Pulse change tracking with Search Console.

plugins.name: traffic-drop-detective
plugins.description: Diagnose why a page lost traffic, separating a change you made from an external cause, using Page Pulse change tracking with Search Console and GA4.

plugins.name: pre-deploy-seo-guard
plugins.description: Check what a page is already winning before you ship an edit to it, so you don't overwrite a ranking page, using Page Pulse with Search Console.

plugins.name: quick-win-finder
plugins.description: Find the highest-leverage SEO moves available right now (striking-distance queries, CTR gaps, recoverable slips), using Page Pulse with Search Console.

plugins.name: content-brief
plugins.description: Build a writer-ready content brief grounded in a page's real Search Console query data, not guessed keywords, using Page Pulse.
